parameters.name: body
parameters.description: [MOD-DI-MSG-1] MsgStoreDigest stores a digest on behalf of a corporation.

corporation.description:
corporation is the policy_address of the corporation on whose behalf
this message is executed.

signer.description:
signer is a delegate authorized by corporation, or corporation itself
on the group-proposal path.

digest.description:
digest is the digest string to store. It is opaque to the chain: bounded at
256 bytes, but no format is imposed and it is never recomputed against any
content. For a credential digest this is the digestJCS; the algorithm is
resolved from the digest_algorithm of the governing CredentialSchema.

verana.di.v1.MsgStoreDigest.description: [MOD-DI-MSG-1] MsgStoreDigest stores a digest on behalf of a corporation.

verana.di.v1.MsgStoreDigestResponse.description: MsgStoreDigestResponse defines the response for MsgStoreDigest.
